name: DupeLens — Duplicate & Similar Photo Finder (Quarantine, Never Delete)
description:
The same photo lives in my library three, four, five times — how do I find the duplicates and similar shots without ever risking my only copy of a memory? Duplicate finders promise to clean this up, and then they scare you: inaccurate matches, false positives, and a "Delete" button one click from your only copy of a memory.
DupeLens is built the opposite way: find everything, prove everything, delete nothing.
WHAT IT FINDS
• Exact duplicates — bit-for-bit identical files, matched by SHA-256
• Near-duplicates — the same photo resized or re-compressed (the copies phones, messaging apps and exports create), matched by perceptual hashing
• Adjustable sensitivity — threshold 0–32, default 6; every match in the report shows its measured distance, so you can judge it yourself
THE SAFETY PROMISE — READ THIS BEFORE YOU COMPARE
• DupeLens NEVER deletes a photo. Extra copies are moved into a "DupeLens-Quarantine" folder on your own disk.
• Every move is recorded in a restore manifest. One restore puts every file back in its original folder — and if a new file sits at an original path, the restored file is renamed instead of overwriting it.
• Prefer to look first? Scan-only mode moves nothing and just writes the report.
THE RE-CHECK REPORT (OUR SIGNATURE)
After quarantining, DupeLens re-scans your library and reports in plain language: how many photos were scanned, how many groups were found, what was kept and what was quarantined (from → to, per file), how much space was freed, how many duplicate groups remain (target: zero), and that every keeper is still exactly where it was.
WHICH COPY IS KEPT — A RULE, NOT A GUESS
Highest resolution wins; ties break by largest file, then earliest date. The keeper and the reason are printed in the report for every group.
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
On a seeded 7-photo test library with known ground truth (one photo in 4 copies — original, byte-identical, resized, re-compressed; one photo in 2 copies; one unique photo): both groups found, resized copy measured distance 0/64, re-compressed copy distance 2/64, unrelated photos distance 38, 0 false positives, post-quarantine re-scan 0 groups remaining, all 7 originals accounted for and byte-intact, restore verified — 27/27 acceptance checks passed. A 300-photo test library scanned in under a second on the test machine.
100% LOCAL & PRIVATE — no upload, no account, no subscription. Your family photos never leave your computer. Competitors charge $20–50 per YEAR for this; DupeLens is $29 once.
Windows 10/11, no other software needed. Works on JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, GIF and TIFF photos.
Honest limits: perceptual matching catches resizes and re-compression; heavy edits (strong crops, filters) can push a copy past the threshold and be missed — widen the threshold if you want a bigger net, and check the distances in the report. HEIC/RAW files are not decoded in this version. And keep the quarantine folder until you've reviewed the report — that's what it's for.
